title: Free Rental Audit in Pondicherry for Owners Abroad
description: Is your Puducherry house or shop earning the right rent? We check its condition, tenant and rent, and send a written report. Book your free rental audit.
h1: Free Rental Audit and Property Check in Pondicherry
lead: You cannot fix what you cannot see. We visit your property in Pondicherry or Kottakuppam, film every room or unit, check the rent against what the street is paying now, and send you a written report in three working days.

service.name: Free Rental Audit and Property Check for Owners Abroad

wa: Hi, I live in ___ and I want the free property check for my property in ___

bullets: The rent each unit is paying against current market rent on the same street
The rental agreement — term, escalation clause, expiry, deposit held
Payment history and any outstanding dues
Condition: leaks, damp, wiring, paint, doors, security, water supply
Pending property tax, electricity and water bills
Vacancy, and what is keeping a unit empty
A full walk-through video of the property as it stands today
A written Property Health Report with the rent gap stated in rupees
A 90-day action plan, in the order the work should be done
Our honest view on whether to hold, re-let at a revised rent, or sell

paras: Because owners abroad have been promised things by phone for years and have no reason to trust another promise. The report is yours whether or not you engage us. We earn only if you ask us to fix what it finds.

If you then want us to look after the property, see our [NRI property management service](/nri-property-management-pondicherry), or read the guide to [managing a Pondicherry property from abroad](/guides/manage-pondicherry-property-from-abroad).

items.q: Do I have to be in India?
items.a: No. That is the point of it. We coordinate access with whoever holds the key, and everything comes to you on WhatsApp and email.
The visit is arranged within a few days of your request, and the written report follows within three working days of the visit.

items.q: Is there any obligation after the report?
items.a: None. If you choose to engage us, management is 10% of the rent we collect plus GST.
